workflows.title: How to apply for a service
example_questions: How do I apply for a job?
How can I apply for a service?
Why can't I apply?
steps: Open Services from the sidebar.
Find an available listing under Latest post.
Click Apply to open the application form.
Fill in your name, years of experience, gender, age, and phone number.
Optionally add a short description of up to 100 words.
Click Submit application.
Open Applications to check your application status.
rules: The listing must still have pending status.
You cannot apply to your own listing.
You can apply only once per service.
An application can be blocked if its service time overlaps another pending or approved application.
Years of experience must be between 0 and 60.
Age must be between 1 and 120.
workflows.success_message: Application sent. The owner will review it.
workflows.clarification_question: What message appears when you try to apply?

workflows.title: Create a service request
example_questions: How do I post a service?
How do I find a pet sitter?
steps: Open Create Service.
Select the pet type and service type.
Enter the number of pets, service date, time, and duration.
Select the location and enter the salary you wish to offer
Optionally enter a full address and description with care instructions.
Click Submit.
Your listing appears on Services and sitters can apply.
rules: Pet types are Dog, Cat, Rabbit, and Bird.
Service types are Pet Sitting, Pet Day Care, Pet Taxi, Pet Training, and Dog Walking.
Locations are Petaling Jaya, Bukit Bintang, Bukit Jalil, Puchong, and Cheras.
The number of pets must be at least 1.
Salary must be greater than 0.
The service date and time must be in the future, using Malaysia time.
Choose a duration from the available options.
Full address and description are optional.
The full address is hidden from public listings and shown to the approved sitter.
A new listing starts with pending status and is available for applications; it does not require admin approval.

workflows.title: Review sitter applications
example_questions: Where can I see who applied?
How do I review sitter applications?
steps: Open Applications.
Use the Pending, Approved, or Rejected filter to find applications.
Read the applicant details and available ratings and reviews.
For a pending application, decide whether to approve or reject the sitter.
rules: This page shows applications for your own service requests.
Posting a service does not automatically assign a sitter.

workflows.title: Approve or reject a sitter
example_questions: How do I choose a sitter?
What happens when I approve an application?
How do I reject an application?
steps: Open Applications and find the pending application.
Click Approve to select the sitter, or Reject to decline the application.
Confirm your choice in the confirmation dialog.
rules: You can manage applications only for your own services.
Approving an application assigns that sitter to the service.
The selected application becomes approved and the service becomes ongoing.
Other applications for that service become rejected automatically.
The selected sitter receives a notification.
Other applicants who were still pending receive a not-selected notification.
Rejecting an application notifies that sitter that they were not selected.

workflows.title: Service cancellation availability
example_questions: How do I cancel a service?
Can I cancel after a sitter is assigned?
steps: Open Services to check the listing stage.
For an unassigned listing under Latest post, use the delete-listing workflow if you want to remove it.
rules: There is currently no Cancel service button or service-cancellation route.
Deleting a listing removes its related applications and reviews; it is not a booking-cancellation workflow.
Do not mark an unfinished booking as complete to cancel it.

workflows.title: Mark a service as complete
example_questions: How do I complete a booking?
What should I do after the visit?
steps: After the booked visit is finished, open Applications.
Find the approved sitter application for the service.
Click Mark as complete.
Confirm the action.
rules: You can complete only your own services.
The service must have ongoing or approved status.
The service status changes to completed.
The assigned sitter receives a completion notification.
After completion, you can rate and review the assigned sitter.

workflows.title: Rate and review a sitter
example_questions: How do I rate my sitter?
Why can't I leave a review?
steps: Open Applications and find the approved application for the completed service.
Click Rate & review.
Select a rating from 1 to 5 stars.
Optionally write a comment.
Click Save review.
rules: The service must be completed before you can review it.
The service must belong to you and have an assigned sitter.
Only one review is allowed per service.
The rating must be an integer from 1 to 5.
The optional comment must not exceed 2000 characters.
The sitter receives a notification after the review is saved.

workflows.title: Edit your profile
example_questions: How do I change my profile?
How can I update my information?
steps: Open Profile.
Edit your username, gender, email address, and phone number directly in the form.
Leave the password fields empty unless you want to change your password.
Click Save Changes.
rules: Profile editing is available to signed-in pet owners, pet sitters, and admins.
Username, email, and phone number are required.
The email address cannot already belong to another account.
Gender choices are Male, Female, and Prefer not to say.
Click Cancel to reset unsaved form changes.

workflows.title: View your booking schedule
example_questions: How do I view my schedule?
Where is my calendar?
How do I see next week’s bookings?
Why is my booking missing from Schedule?
steps: Open Schedule from the sidebar to see My Schedule.
Use the left and right arrows to move between weeks. The week runs Monday through Sunday.
Click Today to return to the current week.
Click a booking block to see its date, time, duration, pet details, location, and salary.
Check Assigned Sitter in the details when a sitter is assigned.
rules: Your schedule includes your services with approved or ongoing status.
Pending and completed services are excluded.
Approval assigns the sitter and makes the booking appear in the schedule.
The calendar places bookings by their start date and time, with visible start times from 07:00 up to but not including 22:00.
If a booking is missing, check the selected week, booking start time, and Applications status. An empty week does not mean you have no bookings in other weeks.
Use Applications or Services to check bookings that do not appear in the calendar.

workflows.title: View your pet-sitting schedule
example_questions: How do I view my schedule?
Where is my calendar?
How do I see next week’s bookings?
Why is my booking missing from Schedule?
steps: Open Schedule from the sidebar to see My Schedule.
Use the left and right arrows to move between weeks. The week runs Monday through Sunday.
Click Today to return to the current week.
Click a booking block to see its date, time, duration, pet details, location, and salary.
Check the booking details for the owner and address information.
rules: Your schedule includes applications with approved status; pending and rejected applications are excluded.
The current schedule filters by application status, not service status, so an approved application can remain visible after the service is completed.
Booking details show the full address if the owner provided it. Otherwise, the dialog shows the owner name and phone number when available.
The calendar places bookings by their start date and time, with visible start times from 07:00 up to but not including 22:00.
If a booking is missing, check the selected week, booking start time, and Applications status. An empty week does not mean you have no bookings in other weeks.
Use Applications or Services to check bookings that do not appear in the calendar.

workflows.title: View your service requests and history
example_questions: Where are my posted services?
How do I see completed bookings?
Why did my listing disappear?
steps: Open Services.
Choose All, Latest post, Upcoming, or Completed.
Use Pet type, Types of services, and Location to refine the open listings.
rules: Only your own service requests appear.
Latest post contains pending listings whose start time has not passed.
Upcoming contains approved or ongoing services until you mark them complete.
Completed contains services marked complete.

workflows.title: Edit a service description
example_questions: How do I edit a listing?
Can I change the service date?
How do I update care instructions?
steps: Open Services and find the listing under Latest post.
Click Edit.
Update the description in the Update description prompt and confirm.
rules: The Edit action changes only the description.
The current editing form does not change the date, time, duration, salary, pet details, or address.
You can edit only your own listing.

workflows.title: Delete an unassigned service listing
example_questions: How do I delete my post?
How do I remove an unassigned service?
steps: Open Services and find the listing under Latest post.
Click Delete.
Confirm Delete this listing? only if you want to remove it.
rules: The listing Delete button is shown under Latest post.
Deleting a service also deletes its associated applications and reviews.
You can delete only your own service.

workflows.title: Browse available jobs and service history
example_questions: How do I find available jobs?
Can I filter jobs by location?
Where are my completed jobs?
steps: Open Services.
Browse open listings and use Pet type, Types of services, and Location to refine them.
Open an available application form with Apply.
Use Upcoming to view assigned active jobs and Completed to view finished jobs.
rules: Open listings must be pending and must not have a start time in the past.
Listings where your application was rejected are hidden from your available listings.
A pending application is marked as already applied; you cannot submit another application for the same service.
Upcoming and Completed show services assigned to you.

workflows.title: Track your application status
example_questions: How do I check my application?
Was my application approved?
Can I withdraw my application?
steps: Open Applications.
Choose All, Pending, Approved, or Rejected to find your application.
Read the application card and service details.
For an approved booking, open Schedule to check the visit details.
rules: Pending means the owner has not selected or rejected the application yet.
Approved means the owner selected you. It is an application status, not confirmation that the service has been completed.
Rejected means you were not selected.
The current sitter Applications page has no withdrawal or cancellation action.
The assistant cannot determine your actual application status without verified account data.

workflows.title: View and mark notifications as read
example_questions: Where are my notifications?
How do I clear unread notifications?
How do I mark all notifications as read?
steps: Open Notifications.
Choose All, Unread, or Read to filter the list.
Click the Unread badge on a notification to mark it as read.
Click Mark all as read to mark all your notifications as read.
rules: Notifications belong to the signed-in account.
Marking a notification as read does not delete it or change a booking or application.

workflows.title: Change your password in Profile
example_questions: How do I change my password?
Do I need a password to save my profile?
steps: Open Profile.
Enter your current password, new password, and confirmation in the password fields.
Click Save Changes.
rules: All three password fields are required when changing your password.
The current password must be correct and the new password must match its confirmation.
The new password must have at least 8 characters, an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number, and a symbol.
Leave all password fields blank to save other profile changes without changing your password.
Never share passwords or verification codes with the assistant.

workflows.title: Change your profile picture
example_questions: How do I upload an avatar?
How do I change my profile picture?
steps: Open Profile.
Click Edit profile picture and choose an image.
Click Save Changes to upload and save it.
rules: Supported image formats are JPG, PNG, GIF, and WebP.
The image must be 5 MB or smaller.
Selecting an image previews it; Save Changes persists it.

workflows.title: Reset a forgotten password
example_questions: I forgot my password.
How do I reset my password?
My reset code expired.
steps: Open the forgot-password page from the sign-in page.
Enter your registered email and click Send code.
Check your email, including spam, and enter the code on the verification page.
After verification, enter and confirm a new password, then click Update password.
Sign in with your new password.
rules: The reset code has 6 digits and expires after 10 minutes.
Wait 60 seconds between resend requests.
The new password requires at least 8 characters, an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number, and a symbol.
Enter codes and passwords only in the account forms, never in chat.

workflows.title: Ask the assistant about your own records
example_questions: Can you check my bookings?
Can you see my application status?
What personal information can the chatbot retrieve?
steps: Sign in and open Paw Hub Assistant.
Ask about your bookings, applications, or reviews.
Include dates or a status to narrow the results, or ask for the next page when more results are available.
rules: Pet owners can retrieve their service requests, applications to those services, and reviews they wrote.
Pet sitters can retrieve assigned bookings, applications they submitted, and reviews they received.
Admins have separate registration and sitter-rating reports.
Personal lookups use the signed-in account; another user ID in a message cannot select another account.
Each page contains at most 20 records. Booking and application date filters apply to the service start date.
The assistant retrieves current information using read-only tools; it cannot change bookings or applications.
These lookups do not store conversation checkpoints.
